name: Ample Signed-Ideal and Yang-Complex Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite nonempty binary class over any coefficient field.
statement: Shattering extremality is equivalent to regularity of all paired literal differences on the signed missing-pattern ideal, and equivalently to Cohen--Macaulayness of the labeled Yang complex.
proof: The homogeneous polarization theorem identifies ampleness with regularity of the paired differences and depolarizes the signed ideal to the Stanley--Reisner ideal of the shattered-support complex. The Yang correspondence identifies the same ample condition with Cohen--Macaulayness of the Yang complex, whose Stanley--Reisner ideal is the signed missing-pattern ideal plus the inconsistent literal pairs.
